Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of discovery:
- Use case: customer support ticket summarization + real-time agent assist for high-volume channels.
- Traffic profile: ~200 reqs/min during peak, average prompt length ~120 tokens, expected 50k API calls/month.
- Success metrics: 15-20% reduction in AHT, maintain >95% fidelity on extracted entities.
- Data sensitivity: PII in free text; need SOC2 + optional VPC/private deployment for production.

Proposed next steps (by owner):
1) Marissa: provide discovery notes and cost baseline (attached).
2) FinTechCo: confirm priority and any compliance blockers (CC Priya).
3) Dev/SE (Vivek & Dev): prep a short architecture sketch and onboarding timeline if we move to Dedicated/Private.
4) CS (Rachel): outline a staged pilot plan (2-week POC + 4-week ramp).

Target timeline: aim to start pilot in Q1 if priority remains high.

Attachments: 20261130-discovery-notes.pdf (summary + sample prompts).

Would love a confirmation of the proposed next steps and whether you want us to share a short technical deck for the pilot.

Thanks,

Marissa —
I reviewed the discovery notes. Quick technical asks I’d want on day 0:
- Sample anonymized transcripts (or a QA pipeline we can run to strip PII)
- Target RPS by endpoint and expected peak concurrency
- Typical prompt/response token sizes (you mentioned ~120 tokens average)
- Any redaction requirements (PII categories to remove)

If they require Private/VPC deployment we should plan for a 4-6 week onboard effort (infra + security review). For a Hosted pilot we can run a POC in 1-2 weeks with rate-limited traffic and synthetic data.

I attached a short list of technical asks and a suggested architecture sketch: fintechco-technical-asks.docx

Track B — Private POC (longer): 4-6 weeks, production data, full security reviews, we need SSO/KMS details up front.
